target.name: Helios Strategic Mortgage Income Fund, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Each Fund’s shares of common stock are listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

announcement.quote: HELIOS STRATEGIC MORTGAGE INCOME FUND, INC. HELIOS TOTAL RETURN FUND, INC.

deals.notes: Announcement is the N-14 filed 2011-11-22 (joint proxy statement/prospectus for the HSM into HTR reorganization); the shown excerpt only names the two funds, the clearest sentence naming the merger is in the 2012-02-29 DEFA14A: 'proposed reorganization of HSM into HTR'. The meeting was adjourned on 2012-02-29 to March 16, 2012 for lack of sufficient votes; no filing in the excerpts states the final result. The RW of 2012-08-01 concerns a 2007 Form N-2 registration statement, not the N-14, so it does not settle this deal.
